wake_plan.adjustment_policy: These are planned targets, not reported sleep or waking. Use a newer user-reported wake/start time in preference to the target. If the target is difficult, propose holding it rather than adding overdue work. Move bedtime earlier with the wake target.

work_rhythm.earlier_start_policy: Keep the workload similar and finish earlier; do not expand required work just because the day starts earlier.

breaks.guitar: Use two or three 10–15 minute breaks for guitar; leave other breaks free.

priorities.initial: Complete an accurate application-ready resume; target the first application by the end of the morning application block on October 16.
priorities.ongoing: Protect the first two focus blocks for applications, role selection, tailored resume changes, and follow-ups. A normal target is one or two suitable applications, scaled to each application. Schedule submissions by the learner, not automatic submission.
priorities.python: Two 50-minute blocks with one exercise at a time, beginning with brief retrieval and the latest verified handoff.
priorities.other_prep: Use remaining focus blocks for system design and project/behavioral stories; rotate as progress warrants.
priorities.daily_review: Record actual outcomes and blockers, and set the next concrete action. Do not treat a scheduled block as completed work.

calendar_policy.recurrence: Create one-off events for the planned date only.
calendar_policy.duplicates: Search and fully page the date first. Match events to the marker and block key. Reuse correct events; read before updating changed events; never create a duplicate after an uncertain write.
calendar_policy.existing_commitments: Check availability on visible personal calendars and preserve unrelated events. Do not move existing personal commitments.
calendar_policy.verification: Read back the target day's events, check times, overlaps and expected counts; report any partial failure without claiming success.

daily_reports.preference_scope: Today's actual report; not a permanent change to wake targets or morning routine.
